items.text: Redirect check freeze — the health detect redirect flow no longer blocks the whole app while a check runs.
Title fetch & retest-all — bookmark title recovery and the bulk Retest all action give clearer progress and safer concurrency.
Bookmarks Context (B4) — the collapsible Context panel sits inside the fused bookmarks-tab-surface with flatter toggle styling.
Collections editor (B8) — the edit panel lives inside collections-tab-surface instead of a floating card.
List-tab shell (A2/A6) — Pages, Categories, Tags, Finders, and Collections share config-list-tab; Finders filter uses the shared config-filter-input / clear button.
Empty states (B11) — collections and bookmark detail empty states use the hidden attribute consistently.
Breadcrumb context (B14) — compact path shows Tags filter, Stats section + period, and Collections edit selection.
General rhythm (A10/B6) — Tours & onboarding rows use config-action-list; section gaps use --config-tab-gap.
Skip tour persistence — Skip tour always marks the tour completed on the server (and in localStorage) so guided tours never auto-start again after skip.
Config → Help (EN / NL / DE / FR) — What's new recap and tab-bar help document v2026.07.01.5.
README, MANUAL, CHANGELOG — release notes for v2026.07.01.5; Playwright config suite extended for B4/B8, B11/B14, A2/A6/A10/B6, and tour skip.
